description: Command-line tool for generating regular expressions from user-provided test cases
name: grex

options.description: Converts any Unicode decimal digit to \d
name: -d
--digits

options.description: Converts any character which is not a Unicode decimal digit to \D
name: -D
--non-digits

options.description: Converts any Unicode whitespace character to \s
name: -s
--spaces

options.description: Converts any character which is not a Unicode whitespace character to \S
name: -S
--non-spaces

options.description: Converts any Unicode word character to \w
name: -w
--words

options.description: Converts any character which is not a Unicode word character to \W
name: -W
--non-words

options.description: Detects repeated non-overlapping substrings and converts them to {min,max} quantifier notation
name: -r
--repetitions

options.description: Replaces all non-ASCII characters with unicode escape sequences
name: -e
--escape

options.description: Converts astral code points to surrogate pairs if --escape is set
options.name: --with-surrogates

options.description: Performs case-insensitive matching, letters match both upper and lower case
name: -i
--ignore-case

options.description: Replaces non-capturing groups by capturing ones
name: -g
--capture-groups

options.description: Provides syntax highlighting for the resulting regular expression
name: -c
--colorize

options.description: Reads test cases on separate lines from a file
name: -f
--file

options.description: Specifies the minimum quantity of substring repetitions to be converted if --repetitions is set [default: 1]
options.name: --min-repetitions

options.description: Specifies the minimum length a repeated substring must have in order to be converted if --repetitions is set [default: 1]
options.name: --min-substring-length
